design: Discovery-informed retrospective internal prognostic evaluation; prior participant/outcome exposure acknowledged. No untouched or external validation claim.

population.SWEDD: Excluded from main and activated sensitivities. No new case-control classification.
population.genetic_cohort: Five baseline participants with native pre-index PD diagnosis retained; PD-recruitment-only sensitivity prespecified.
population.source: Exact verified audit row bindings; no new endpoint selection, value changes or exclusions by RNA-outcome association.
population.timing: RNA collection month-end landmark; SC/BL dynamic predictors within prior three months; MoCA windows 9..15,21..27,33..39. Source monthly precision and same-month ambiguity retained.
population.optional_clinical_missingness: Five missing diagnosis durations retained; training-only imputation and fixed missing indicators.

outcome.source_score_rules: Audit_Rules.json plus source hashes preserved; no threshold-defined MCI/dementia labels.

clinical_preprocessing.numeric: Training median imputation, all-missing training column ->0. Training mean and population-SD scaling of imputed values; SD<=1e-12 ->1. Fixed missing indicator for every numeric column, unscaled.
clinical_preprocessing.categorical: Fixed complete one-hot dictionaries, no dropped level; blank/invalid raw values become unknown during binding. No outcome-derived vocabulary.
clinical_preprocessing.intercept: Unpenalized; all design columns centred within solver training rows.

RNA.counts: Original int64 raw counts; exact count_row/sample/versioned gene binding. No DESeq2/global-normalized expression, global PCs, label-based genes, ComBat or full-cohort learned transformations.
RNA.normalization: Per-sample log2(1+1e6*count/sum_all_58780_gene_counts). Denominator is all raw genes, not selected panel. Deterministic sample-local, no fitting across participants.

training_gene_gate.rule: For selected mapped gene union only: raw count >=10 in at least max(3,ceil(0.20*n_training)) training samples, and nonconstant logCPM. Fit separately within each inner training and outer refit partition.

RNA.genes5: Five fixed candidates, exact versions; apply training gate and training z-score. Failed gate -> fixed zero column, labelled inactive, no replacement.
RNA.hallmark11: Keep full frozen mapped membership; average eligible training-z-scored gene expression per set, then standardize pathway mean using training mean/population SD. At least 5 eligible members per set. Failure or constant score -> fixed zero inactive pathway column.
RNA.fixed_layout: 5 standalone and/or 11 ordered pathway columns; inactive columns remain zero and are recorded in every preprocessing state. No selection by cognitive association.
RNA.all_RNA_inactive: Do not remove participants. Record degeneracy; predictions may reduce to clinical model. No post-result feature substitutions.
RNA.NPIPB8: Exact GENCODE v29 ENSG00000255524.7 and exon length2338 match the original counts. This does not prove unique-read/paralog assay specificity. Retain main fixed panel; prespecified sensitivity removes its standalone feature. If it is a member of a pathway, remove it there too in that sensitivity.

model.RNA_off: Each augmented arm includes the five clinical-only candidates as a genuine RNA-off option. Inner clinical-only fits shared among augmented arms in that view.
model.tuning: Pooled inner-validation absolute error over all inner held-out participants, not unweighted mean of fold means. Select only within outer training cohort.
model.tie: Within absolute1e-12 of minimum pooled MAE: prefer RNA-off, then larger RNA penalty, then larger clinical penalty. Clinical-only ties prefer larger clinical penalty.
model.outer_refits: One independent outer-training refit per requested arm, including arms selecting RNA-off. No full-cohort final fit in this evaluation.
model.no_adaptation: No grid expansion, early stopping, hyperparameter revisions or representation changes after scores.

splits.algorithm: Deterministic SHA256 order within strata; allocate to least-used fold within stratum, then least-used total, then salted fold-hash tie. For each outer fold, allocate its training components into three inner folds with a distinct salt. Outer test components have inner=-1.
splits.reuse: One master allocation, subset unchanged for every horizon and sensitivity. No outcome values or follow-up availability used to create splits.

metrics.primary: Raw, unclipped paired MAE difference augmented minus comparator; negative favours augmentation.
metrics.calibration: Observed y on raw OOF prediction; slope/intercept undefined if prediction range<=1e-12 or centred sum of squares is zero. Range tolerance avoids false nonzero variance from floating-point means.
metrics.clipping: No clipping for tuning or primary metrics. Fixed [0,30] clipped MAE descriptive only; no retuning.

benchmarks.typical_change: Baseline MoCA plus median(y-baseline_MoCA) in the outer-training participants for the same horizon/view. No held-out outcomes; not counted as ridge fitting.

inference.resampling_unit: participant/identity component paired across model predictions
inference.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentiles of paired delta-MAE; conditional on fixed OOF predictions, not full-refitting uncertainty.
inference.secondary_status: All other contrasts and horizons exploratory/descriptive with no confirmatory multiplicity or novelty claim. Report every locked result.
inference.clinical_significance: No established clinical-utility threshold claimed for a MAE change; report absolute and relative differences without calling them an MoCA MCID.

execution.future_gate: Explicit future user authorization recorded outside this frozen package, matching PLAN_LOCK SHA and selected view IDs. Output must be a fresh directory within Clinical_hallmark.
execution.failure_policy: Any fit/numerical/coverage-input integrity failure aborts run and leaves failure marker. Never silently skip failed jobs, return partial success or overwrite existing output.

not_activated: CBC modelling until a separate raw-value/unit/timing contract is verified

technical_sensitivity.paired: Add the same technical variables to both enhanced clinical-only and RNA-augmented arms. No global residualization or plate effects learned using test rows.

budget.interpretation: Planned future solutions, not executed. Inner clinical-only candidate fits cached within each view; no reuse across views. Outer refit per arm counted even when RNA-off wins.
